question: As of 31st July 2025, which of the following is the official language of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chinese**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO)** recognizes two official languages: **Chinese** and **Russian**. Among these, **Chinese** is one of the most prominently used languages.
 
• The inclusion of **Chinese** as an official language reflects the geopolitical influence of **China**, as it is one of the founding members of the SCO and a major regional power.
 
• The SCO was founded in **2001** in Shanghai, and its official languages were established to facilitate communication among member states.
 
• The language is used for **official documentation, meetings, and communications** within the organization, ensuring inclusivity for Chinese-speaking nations.
 
• Countries like **China**, which is a permanent member, actively promote the use of Chinese as a medium to strengthen their diplomatic and cultural ties with other member nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO):**

 
 
• The SCO is a **political, economic, and security alliance** comprising eight member countries: **China, Russia, India, Pakistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan,** and **Uzbekistan**.
 
• The organization was officially established on **15 June 2001**, and its headquarters are located in **Beijing, China**.
 
• The SCO focuses on promoting regional cooperation in areas such as **security, trade, culture, and development**.
 
• The **observer states** of the SCO include Afghanistan, Belarus, Iran, and Mongolia, while countries like Turkey and Sri Lanka are **dialogue partners**.
 
 
 
• **Official Languages of the SCO:**
 
 
• The SCO recognizes **Chinese** and **Russian** as its official languages for all its operations and communications.
 
• These languages were chosen due to the significant role played by **China and Russia** in the formation and functioning of the SCO.
 
• Both languages are used for **documentation, translations, and official meetings** within the organization.
 
 
 
• **China's Role in the SCO:**
 
 
• China is one of the **founding members** of the SCO and plays a key role in shaping its agenda and priorities.
 
• The country's economic and diplomatic influence is evident in its promotion of **Chinese language and culture** within the organization.
 
• China also contributes significantly to the SCO's **economic and security initiatives**.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Official Languages:**
 
 
• The use of official languages like **Chinese** and **Russian** ensures effective communication and collaboration among member states.
 
• It allows for the **standardization of documents** and facilitates better understanding during multilateral meetings.
 
• These languages also reflect the **cultural and political influence** of the founding member countries.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Russian as an Official Language:**

 
 
• In addition to Chinese, **Russian** is also an official language of the SCO, reflecting the significant role of **Russia** in the organization.
 
• Russia uses the SCO platform to enhance its regional influence and foster cooperation with Central Asian countries.
 
 
 
• **Multilingual Cooperation:**
 
 
• Despite the official use of Chinese and Russian, member countries often collaborate in other languages for bilateral or multilateral initiatives.
 
• This multilingual approach promotes inclusivity and respects the linguistic diversity of member and observer states.
